head: codex/clock-terminal-collector-20261011
title: fix(kpmo): verify external-clock natural chain terminals
body:
Authenticated external-clock Assurance uses upstream=null. The whole-platform collector currently omits these chains because it requires a causal workflow_run parent, and its terminal verifier does not require the actual success-authority-gate job to execute.

Admit EXTERNAL_CLOCK_PROOF_BOUND only after native exact-attempt unique intake success, latest natural Sentinel tuple selection at the Assurance observation boundary, and the archived artifact ID/digest binding. Retain both historical generations and exact nested ZIP/sidecar checks. Require one completed successful authority job for both causal and clock routes; workflow SUCCESS with a skipped job does not prove closure. Manual dispatch remains excluded from natural generations.

Validation: 38 targeted regression/negative tests pass across collector, runtime terminal, operating proof and full Assurance proof. Tests cover causal compatibility, two clock generations, missing/skipped/duplicate/wrong-attempt authority and intake, newer pending/red/mismatched green, duplicate proof tuples, artifact drift and nested archive/sidecar drift. Holistic code-path review preserves failure-closed behavior and scope separation; exact-head remote validation remains required.

Fresh protected main: c4256969da367b8c30be8f9640092aef028735a2. Natural Sentinel 38094866490/1 is VERIFIED_PASS for bounded core content, with runtime_health_proven=false. Artifact 11685113796 archive SHA256 a3a465931f3e6bc73c1b3dda9c1822124066e3272676c9f8d652f7ad4bb77686 was byte-verified. Gate 38095488827 is workflow SUCCESS but actual authority job 114340453911 is SKIPPED. Dispatcher 38095032919 fails LIFECYCLE_BROKER_NOT_VERIFIED; this correction does not resolve that separate blocker.
